passages.title: I Remember Grade 7
passages.body: As I look back at my three years in junior high, many happy memories come to my mind. I remember meeting all of you in Grade 7. I was very nervous on my first day. I didn't know anyone. But soon I made many good friends. I remember our first sports day, when our class won the basketball competition. I also remember the kind teachers who helped me grow. I used to be shy, but now I am much more confident. Time has gone by so quickly. Soon we will graduate and go to different senior high schools. I will always be thankful to my teachers and friends. These three years have been the best of my life.

passages.title: A Teacher's Speech
passages.body: Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for coming today to attend the graduation ceremony at No. 3 Junior High School. First of all, I want to congratulate all the students who are here today. I remember meeting all of you when you were just starting Grade 7 three years ago. At that time, you were just children. But now, you have grown into fine young men and women. Although you have all worked very hard over the last three years, your real test is still ahead of you. Soon you will go to senior high school, and the work will be much harder. But I believe you are ready. Remember to keep your cool when things are difficult. Believe in yourselves, and you can overcome any problem. Good luck, and I hope to see you again sometime in the future.

passages.title: Changes in Junior High
passages.body: Junior high school is a time of great change. Students change a lot in these three years. When they first arrive in Grade 7, they are young and often shy. By the time they graduate, they have grown taller and become more confident. Their study habits change, too. In Grade 7, many students need help from teachers. By Grade 9, most have learned to study on their own. Students also become more responsible. They learn to keep their cool when faced with problems. They make new friends and learn to work as a team. These three years are not always easy, but they help students grow into better people, ready for the challenges of senior high school.

passages.title: Looking to the Future
passages.body: Now that junior high is almost over, it is time to look to the future. Many students feel both excited and a little worried about senior high school. The work will be harder, and there will be new challenges. But change is a part of growing up. There are some things you can do to get ready. First, set clear goals. Think about what you want to achieve. Second, work hard, but also keep your cool when things get difficult. Third, believe in yourself. If you believe you can do it, you are already halfway there. Remember, every new beginning is a chance to grow. So spread your wings and fly. The future is full of hope, and it belongs to you.

passages.title: My Plans for the Future
passages.body: My name is Lily, and I am about to graduate from junior high school. When I look back, I remember being a quiet girl in Grade 7. Now I have many friends and big dreams. So what are my plans for the future? First, I am going to work hard in senior high school. I want to get good grades so that I can go to a good university. After that, I am going to study science. I have always been thirsty for knowledge. In ten years, I hope I will be a doctor. I want to help sick people and make the world a better place. I know the road ahead will not be easy. But I believe that if I keep trying, I will reach my goals one day.

passages.title: Graduation Ceremony Notice
passages.body: GRADUATION CEREMONY — CLASS OF GRADE 9! Dear students, our graduation ceremony is coming soon. Here are the details. DATE: Friday, June 28th. TIME: 9:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m. PLACE: The school hall. WHAT TO WEAR: Please wear your school uniform. THE PROGRAM: First, our head teacher will give a speech. Then, we will give out the graduation certificates. After that, a few students will share their memories of these three years. Lastly, we will take a class photo together. This is an important day. It is a time to look back at our happy memories and look ahead to a bright future. We hope to see all of you there. Let's celebrate this special moment together!
